name: United Parcel Service
outlook:
What United Parcel Service says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenue and operating profitFor the fourth quarter of 2026, on a consolidated basis, UPS expects revenue to be approximately $25.7 billion and non-GAAP adjusted operating profit of approximately $3.3 billion.
  • Full year 2026: revenue, profit, EPS and free cash flowFor the full year 2026, the company now expects consolidated revenue of approximately $92.6 billion, non-GAAP adjusted operating profit of approximately $8.75 billion, non-GAAP adjusted diluted EPS of approximately $7.28, and non-GAAP adjusted free cash flow of approximately $6.1B.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
